steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8096/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then open the project named 'Bench Project' and report the titles of all tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. Do not modify anything.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in Vikunja, create a new task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task'. Give it a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Set its due date to 2026-12-31 and its priority to High. Do not touch the tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Then open the new task's own page and report: the task title, the description text, the due date, the priority, and the task identifier exactly as the app displays it on the task's page (it looks like BENCH-<number>).

03-create: On the Vikunja task page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (at {{02-create.task_url}}), attach the EXISTING label named 'Backend' to this task. Important: the label field creates a NEW label from whatever text is typed, so you must choose the existing 'Backend' label from the suggestion dropdown that appears when you type 'Back' — do not just press enter on typed text if that would create a new label. Verify afterwards that the task shows the label 'Backend' and that no duplicate/new label was created (e.g. check the project's list of available labels still has only one 'Backend'). Report exactly what the task page shows for the label.

04-add: On the Vikunja task page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (at {{02-create.task_url}}), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit it, then verify the comment is displayed on the task page and report the exact comment text shown, plus confirm the task still shows identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}, title '{{runid}} Bench Task', label 'Backend', priority High, due date 31 Dec 2026, and description containing '{{runid}}'.

05-open: Final verification, read-only, do not modify anything: (1) Open the project 'Bench Project' in Vikunja and report the titles of all tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:' exactly as shown. (2) Open the task page for the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}) and report exactly: the identifier shown on the task page, the title, the description text, the due date, the priority, the label(s) attached, and the text of any comments. Report these as concrete values read from the page.
